title: kanban: a lane's sum statistic is totalled in the query over the whole lane, not over the loaded cards
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the contract review of PR #36411 (card #36370, finding S3) on 2026-11-22. Filed by the seat, not claimed.

## What happens

A board's lane statistic `summary: { type: 'sum', field }` is added up in the browser over the cards a lane has loaded. A paged board loads 50 per lane, so on a longer lane the figure is only a partial sum. #36411 labels it 「loaded cards」 so it is not mistaken for the lane total. `count` already reads the server's lane count, but `sum` does not.

## What should happen

The lane sum is the total of every record in the lane, computed in the query (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 5, SQL first), with the same filters and read permissions as the board. The 「loaded cards」 wording goes away once the figure is the full total.

## Done when

- The lane read returns the per-lane sum from one grouped aggregate query, with no fetch-then-add in the app, and it honours the board's filters and the reader's record and field permissions. A field the reader cannot read gives no figure.
- The board draws that figure. A lane longer than the page size shows the full total, pinned with a lane of more than 50 records.
- The `summary` docblock and `.describe()` say it totals the lane's records, which is then true.
